tasks.name: guard chunked() against negative n
tasks.description: chunked(iterable, n) has no guard for a negative n. Calling chunked([1,2,3], -1) currently leaks itertools.islice's internal error message ('Stop argument for islice() must be None or an integer: 0 <= x <= sys.maxsize') instead of a clear one. Add an up-front check: if n is not None and n < 0, raise ValueError('n must be at least 0'). n=None (single chunk) and n=0 (empty result) must keep their existing behavior, unchanged. Do not change any other behavior of chunked() or take().
step_by_step_implementation: At the top of chunked(), before any other logic, check: if n is not None and n < 0.
If that check is true, raise ValueError('n must be at least 0').
Leave the rest of chunked() and take() exactly as they are.

test_triad.negative: chunked('ABCDE', -1) raises ValueError matching 'n must be at least 0', not islice's internal error
test_triad.negative_to_positive: after the ValueError, chunked('ABCDE', 3) still works normally
